# USGS Sites
```{r}
library(dataRetrieval)
```
## Elmwood
The closest USGS sensor to my sites in Elmwood Park is Little Papillion Creek at Ak-Sar-Ben at Omaha
```{r}
usgs_elmwood <- "USGS-06610765"
```
## Glacier Creek Preserve
For Glacier Creek Preserve there are two sites that monitor discharge that are relatively equidistant from my site.

- Big Papio near Bennington is upstream
- Big Papio at Fort Street is downstream
```{r}
usgs_gcp_up <- "USGS-06610720"
usgs_gcp_down <- "USGS-06610732"
```
